full_judgment: 6. The defendant, as being the sole DW, in his scanty testimony, in reversal to the general denial he recorded in the written statement, admitted that he did really undertake the responsibility to repay the loan that was granted to Abdul Hai Pathan in the event of the latter's failure to do so. He stated that in view of A Hai Pathan's financial debacle, he was willing to pay the principal amount of Taka 15,000 only, if interests were written off.
